title: Rolling utilization window summary — Apr 15 2026
content:
Summary

This sheet is a rolling-window export of GPU utilization across key clusters and pools for the last 7 days (windowed by 3 daily slices). The goal is to provide operations and capacity planning with:
- short-term headroom signals by slice,
- candidate pools for burst/eviction during surges,
- prioritized actions for balancing and scaling before next week.

Methodology
- Window slices: 00:00-06:00 (night), 06:00-18:00 (day), 18:00-24:00 (evening).
- Sample cadence: 5-minute metrics aggregated to per-slice percent-utilization (GPU occupancy of active slots).
- Smoothing: 3-sample moving median to reduce noise from brief spikes.
- Baseline: target SLO headroom = 20% unoccupied capacity for each pool during day slice.

Per-cluster / per-pool snapshot (7-day rolling avg % util by slice)
Columns: cluster | pool | region | night % | day % | evening % | notes
orion-eu-west-1 | pool-A-rtx6000 | eu-west-1 | 22% | 81% | 73% | day slice above headroom violation (avg 81%)
ceres-na-west | pool-C-3090 | us-west-2 | 18% | 64% | 55% | steady, potential for burst consolidation
atlas-apac-sg | pool-B-a100 | ap-southeast-1 | 12% | 92% | 86% | critical daytime saturation, frequent queuing
sierra-eu-central | pool-D-mi100 | eu-central-1 | 35% | 44% | 40% | headroom comfortable across slices
vulcan-na-east | pool-E-rtx8000 | us-east-1 | 9% | 58% | 61% | underutilized nights, middling day usage

Anomaly highlights (last 7 days)
- Apr 13 14:05 UTC: atlas-apac-sg pool-B-a100 saw sustained 98% occupancy for 27 minutes; queued latency spiked x4. Root cause: unplanned retraining job from solutions-eng (ticket JIRA-TMP-1875).
- Apr 14 02:30 UTC: orion-eu-west-1 pool-A intermittently dropped 6 GPUs due to kernel OOM; resulting in 15% effective capacity loss for 40 minutes. Follow-up: hardware flagged, rack scheduled for maintenance 2026-04-18.

Short-term capacity actions (priority list)
1) Atlas (apac) emergency mitigation — HIGH: move non-urgent batch recs to dedicated spot pool in apac-misc; apply preemptible policy for jobs with checkpointing. Owner: Diego. ETA: 24h.
2) Orion (eu) near-term absorb — MEDIUM: increase dedicated burst cap by +2 slots for pool-A for 48h window starting 2026-04-17 to preserve SLOs during maintenance. Owner: Kai. ETA: 48h.
3) Rebalance candidate pools — LOW: schedule migration of steady low-priority workloads from atlas to sierra during apac night slice to recover 8–12% headroom. Owner: Platform-ops. ETA: next sprint.

Capacity recommendations (operational)
- Adjust autoscale policies for pool-B-a100: lower scale-in aggressiveness and add priority queueing for interactive tokens. Expected impact: reduce daytime respawn latency by 30% while increasing average occupancy to 88%.
- Introduce slice-aware routing: prefer eu pools for eu-routed traffic in day slice to avoid APAC cross-region pressure.
- Reserve short-term dedicated nodes in ap-southeast-1 (2 x a100) as a contingency pool for 72h burn-down in case queued backlog grows > 20% for more than 3 hours.

Forecast notes & capacity delta table (quick)
- Baseline available GPUs (active slots):
  - eu-west-1: 120 slots
  - us-west-2: 80 slots
  - ap-southeast-1: 40 slots
- Current effective usable slots after maintenance/flags:
  - eu-west-1: 114 (-6 maintenance)
  - us-west-2: 80
  - ap-southeast-1: 40
- Estimated additional slots required to regain 20% headroom during day slice next week: 10 slots (all concentrated in ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1).

Operational checklist (for on-call / infra runbook)
- If any pool crosses 95% sustained occupancy for >15 minutes: auto-run eviction-prep (notify job owners, trigger checkpointing).
- If cluster drop events detected (GPU reascent/failure): page infra-sre and create remediation ticket with snapshot + kernel logs.
- For planned rack maintenance, update routing policy 24h before window and pre-warm burst pool.

Open questions / follow-ups
- How many interactive sessions in atlas are pinned to pool-B-a100 vs a fallback model on a100-quantized variants? (Action: Product/Serving to inventory; owner Marta; ETA 3 days)
- Can Optimize generate quantization recommendations for the top 5 heavy jobs to reduce avg tokens/sec cost by 12%? (Action: Optimize team)

Notes-to-self
- Export weekly CSV for leadership with 7-day headroom trendline and an embeddable chart for the console.
- Follow-up meeting with solutions-eng to enforce job tagging and runtime limits.

End of sheet
